basis.selection: iterative design; no dimensions or reinforcement prescribed by grouping
basis.column_story: segment from floor k-1 to floor k belongs to story k
basis.beam_floor: beam at floor k belongs to the band containing k
basis.x_boundary_edge: column at i=0 or i=nx, with j strictly interior
basis.y_boundary_edge: column at j=0 or j=ny, with i strictly interior
basis.symmetry: mirrored positions share groups; earthquake signs and load patterns still enveloped
basis.odd_story_count: merge a final one-story band into the band below; a search policy, not a code rule
